description: This Java class 'SagePayPaymentServices' provides payment processing services for SagePay integration within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for authorization, capture, refund, void, and release of credit card transactions, along with billing info construction.

classes.name: SagePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for SagePay payment operations such as authorization, capture, refund, void, and release within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Constructs billing information map from context, including card details and address, for payment processing.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization requests, invoking payment authentication process.

methods.name: processCardAuthorisationPayment
methods.description: Performs the actual payment authorization by calling SagePayPaymentAuthentication service.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Handles capture of authorized credit card transactions.

methods.name: processCardCapturePayment
methods.description: Performs the capture operation by calling SagePayPaymentAuthorisation service.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes refund requests, deciding between refund or void based on transaction age.

methods.name: processCardRefundPayment
methods.description: Performs refund operation via SagePayPaymentRefund service.

methods.name: processCardVoidPayment
methods.description: Performs void operation via SagePayPaymentVoid service.

methods.name: processCardReleasePayment
methods.description: Performs release operation via SagePayPaymentRelease service.
